DONE: Engine-prefix rewrite pass wired at the engine boundary (commit 3b9a28c68).

Changes:
- internal/tiltfile/worktree/boundary.go: worktree.ApplyBoundary(main, run) rewrites one worktree run's manifests to clone names; deps resolve same-worktree first else main-defined; shared manifests stay bare (worktree's definition wins, plan S3) and return in run order; derived names (DockerImage/LiveUpdate/CmdImage object names, LocalTarget name -> update Cmd) re-stamped with the clone name so main and worktree never overwrite each other's API objects; ImageMap IDs stay ref-derived (per-worktree image identity remains tk-1zq); input immutability preserved (ImageTargets copied before rewrite).
- Clone-name format corrected to wt:<worktree>_<name> (was wt:<worktree>/<name>): the engine name doubles as the apiserver object name (reducers join UIResource/KubernetesApply by equal name) and tilt-apiserver BeforeCreate rejects '/' via IsPathSegmentName; ':' is legal ("(Tiltfile)" precedent). prefix.go + phase-1 tests updated to the new grammar.
- internal/controllers/core/tiltfile/reconciler.go: handleLoaded runs the pass for worktree-labeled Tiltfile CRs before updateOwnedObjects/ConfigsReloadedAction (retires TODO(nick) at that site); main CR's last successful result supplies the shared name set; pass errors become the run's load error; no rewrite on main run or on load errors. applyWorktreeBoundary reads r.runs under the caller-held r.mu (no re-lock).
- internal/controllers/core/tiltfile/reducers.go: shared-flow rule - a worktree run redefining a main-defined manifest replaces main's copy instead of erroring double-define; cross-tiltfile collisions from non-worktree runs still error.
- Tests: boundary_test.go (9 unit tests: main passthrough, clones+deps, shared bare, derived restamp, local target rename, nil-main error, cross-run clones distinct, input immutability), worktree_boundary_test.go (3 reconciler wiring tests: clone rewrite + bare shared dep, main unchanged, no-main-result error), prefix/validate expectations updated to the '_' grammar.

Verification: go test ./internal/tiltfile/... ./internal/engine/... green except pre-existing failures - TestKustomizeFlags/TestKustomizeBin (missing kustomize binary, documented in tk-mxh as out of scope) and engine flakes (TestPodEventUpdateByPodName, TestSecretScrubbed, TestCurrentlyBuildingMayExceedMaxParallelUpdates) that also fail/flake on clean baseline ee0cfda53 (verified via git stash). gofmt/vet clean. discover_test fixture commits needed commit.gpgsign=false (1Password SSH agent signs test commits).

Assumption: the pass runs on successful loads only (tlr.Error == nil); a failed worktree load never dispatches rewritten manifests.
